_comment: Merged over DEFAULT_POLICY in scrub.py. Only listed fields change.

_rationale.FACTS.md: Private working file. Holds all 30 verbatim quotes, ET case numbers and captions. anchors.json exists so this never has to ship.
_rationale.verified_quotes.json: Superseded by anchors.json, which locates the same 30 spans by hash instead of reproducing them.
_rationale.redaction_report / sweep_triage / result: Model outputs that quote judgments back verbatim. Bulky and regenerable from the prompts. If redaction_report is the audit trail for the fulltext-vs-redacted condition, keep a reduced version with the text stripped rather than the raw file.
_rationale.DeonticBench: Third-party benchmark. Not ours to redistribute, and its captions are US immigration cases unrelated to the Find Case Law licence. Same treatment as LexTime and tracie.
_rationale.note/comment: Analytic content, not identifiers. Kept - but the scan gate still runs over them, so a name written into a note fails the build rather than passing silently.
_rationale.csv_columns kept: Annotation vocabulary, not judgment prose. Averages ~60 chars, listed explicitly so the length heuristic cannot start hashing them later.
_rationale.prompts_dump / results_uk/et_*: Judgment text and first-instance ET captions inside file content, where no key rule reaches. results_uk et_* are regenerable from the pipeline.

_known_false_positives.results_contracts_50, results_heideltime: Synthetic contracts using 'Mr X' placeholder parties. Not real people.
_known_false_positives.results_heldout/elgafaji*.json: Elgafaji is a published CJEU judgment, not Find Case Law material and not a private individual.
